title: BasicallyEnoughItems
body:
# BasicallyEnoughItems

This mod is possibly the worst implementation of a RecipeViewer.
I made it, because there's currently no alternative to EMI/JEI/REI for Fabric 1.21.7.

This is basically my first mod, hence the quality.

Current features:
- Press R to see a list of every item (And click to see their recipes)
- Press R on an item to see it's recipes
- Press U on an item so see it's usages in recipes

Current limitations:
- Vanilla items only
- Custom recipes through datapacks are unsupported

Depending on my motivation, I might improve the mod in the future (And properly open-source it)
